mapper.sql: C.COMD_CODE AS ALIM_SITU , C.COMD_NAME AS ALIM_SITU_NAME , C.USEE_YSNO , CASE WHEN I.ALIM_SITU IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS ICON_REGI_YSNO , I.MIME_TYPE , I.FILE_SIZE , I.PIXL_WDTH , I.PIXL_HGHT , COALESCE(TEMP.TEMP_CNT, 0) AS TEMP_CNT , I.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(I.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , I.REGI_DATE , I.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(I.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , I.UPDT_DATE
LEFT JOIN TM_ALICON I ON I.ALIM_SITU = C.COMD_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.ALIM_SITU , COUNT(1) AS TEMP_CNT FROM TB_ALTEMP T GROUP BY T.ALIM_SITU ) TEMP ON TEMP.ALIM_SITU = C.COMD_CODE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getAlimIconListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TB_CODEXD C WHERE C.COMM_CODE = #{alimSitu}
